description: Registered F-AZVM and the last airworthy Noratlas in the world, kept flying by the association Le Noratlas de Provence from Marseille-Provence airport. First flown 24 May 1956; served with the Touraine, Sahara, CIET, Bearn, Anjou, GAMOM 88, Bigorre, CIFAS and Vercors units. Listed as a Monument Historique in 2006 and still flying a full display and paratrooping programme in 2026.
